metadata.title: Spectral gaps of double covers of hyperbolic surfaces
metadata.abstract: We prove that, in most moduli spaces of orientable hyperbolic surfaces of finite area, there exist surfaces all of whose covers of degree two have a new small eigenvalue. On the other hand, we show that four punctured spheres always admit a double cover without new small eigenvalues and that there exist closed surfaces of any genus with the same property. We prove the last two of these results using a version of Cheeger's inequality adapted to double covers.

analysis.progressType: 双覆盖的谱隙与新小特征值
analysis.workSummary: 证明多数有限面积定向双曲曲面模空间中存在所有二重覆盖均有新小特征值的曲面；四穿孔球总有不产生新小特征值的二重覆盖，并构造每个 genus 的闭曲面例子。
analysis.breakthrough: 同时区分必然产生与可避免新小谱的几何情形。
analysis.limitations: 多数模空间不等于所有曲面；存在性结论不能替换为整个模空间的性质。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者说明数学想法由人提出，并披露 ChatGPT 用于文献检索以及检查和测试部分计算。
